description: Find out whether a printed book is available at your Houston Public Library branch or anywhere in HPL, using ChatGPT or Codex.

interface.defaultPrompt: Check these physical print books at HPL Looscan: [titles and authors].
interface.longDescription: Want to find a printed book at Houston Public Library? Ask about a title at your favorite branch or anywhere in HPL. For example: Is The Hobbit by J. R. R. Tolkien available at Heights? This tool helps check for copies and includes library catalog links, availability, and shelf information when it can verify them. It checks printed books, including large print. It does not check ebooks or audiobooks or reserve books. This is an early test version for use with supervision. Setup may need help and does not work with every account. There is no one-click ChatGPT install link yet. Your chat needs access to the live library catalog; the plugin does not provide that access itself. If it cannot finish checking, it says so. Availability can change, and reference copies may not be borrowable. Start with the setup guide on the project website. Independent project by Mit, not affiliated with or endorsed by Houston Public Library.

publication.release_notes: Add host-executed live browser batches with durable observations, explicit identity review, bounded recovery and resumable completion checks. Fresh Codex execution and saved resume verified; automatic installed ChatGPT invocation remains unverified.

name: hpl-physical-book-check
